_comment: Everything documented inside one of the sites in docs-sites.json. The hub renders these in one grid with the sites themselves, so a reader does not have to care which is which. Every url was checked to return 200; the ones with no index page of their own point at their real entry page, which is why some are deeper than you would expect. Hand-maintained, unlike hub-index.json, because what counts as a product is an editorial call rather than a directory listing.
